If you want small, independent, hands-on creative shops in Toronto, rather than a big holding-company agency, I’d look at these:

Smaller Agency — Particularly interesting if you need brand strategy, naming, identity, or packaging. They explicitly operate as a small senior-led studio, with the founder involved directly in projects. 
Smaller Agency
+1

The Local Collective — Independent creative advertising agency in Little Italy, with campaign, design, OOH, social and experiential work.

Made by Emblem — Boutique strategic design/branding studio in 401 Richmond, particularly focused on hospitality, arts and culture, with a small-team feel.

Art & Mechanical — Leslieville-based design studio covering branding, packaging, digital and advertising. A good one to investigate if you want a design-heavy partner.

blok design — Multidisciplinary studio doing identity, art/creative direction, packaging, product and environmental/experience design.

Nomad Cre8tive — A smaller, remote-first studio that assembles specialist teams around projects; services include branding, graphic design, websites and social/content.

Goods & Services Branding — Independently owned studio combining research/strategy, branding, design, communications and digital work.

Neighbourhood Creative — A more culture/community-oriented shop, combining creative, content, social, PR/influencer and experiential work.

Studio 3 Design Co. — A particularly small branding studio aimed at small and mid-sized businesses, with a focus on strategic identity work. 
Studio 3 Design Co.

not so secret — Independent creative + production agency where senior creative and production people work together from the initial brief; they do campaigns, content and brand identity. 
This Is Not So Secret

A few ways I'd narrow it
If you need…	Look at…
Brand identity / rebrand	Smaller Agency, Studio 3, Made by Emblem
Packaging / consumer brand	Smaller Agency, Art & Mechanical
Advertising / campaigns	The Local Collective, not so secret
Design-led work	blok design, Art & Mechanical
Culture / hospitality	Made by Emblem, Neighbourhood Creative
Small-business marketing + creative	Goods & Services, Nomad Cre8tive

I deliberately left out the giant Toronto agencies. Smaller Agency, Made by Emblem, Studio 3, and The Local Collective are probably the first four I'd investigate if your main requirement is “I want to actually work with the people doing the creative, not get passed through layers of account management.” That's based on their publicly described operating models, not a quality ranking. 
Smaller Agency
+1

If you tell me what you need the agency to create (e.g. brand identity, advertising campaign, website, social/content, packaging) and roughly your budget, I can narrow this to 3–5 Toronto shops that fit.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
